page.overview:
Who is Hue Li?

Historically, Jasmine Island's most powerful and rich people were involved in the production of golden jasmine tea, leaving the local fishers and food farmers to occupy a secondary economic role. As a crop farmer himself, Hue Li resented this situation somewhat. Regardless, he was mostly known for his earnest and likeable nature, and thus gradually gained the trust of other farmers and fishers. Eventually, he was made the spokesperson for Jasmine Island's food producers, defending their interests in various situations.

In the 290s BG, a Fifth Nation splinter fleet led by Tagaka, an infamous pirate queen, attacked Jasmine Island. Though the local food producers were generally ready to defend their homes, Hue Li was unwilling to risk any of his fellow farmers and fishers in the defense of the island's tea plants and jasmine groves. As the Jasmine Island protectors organized the anti-pirate defenses, the spokesperson was thus only willing to offer them some limited support.

Hue Li was a generally good-natured and likeable person, but was greatly frustrated and often angered over the way Jasmine Island's leaders and elites favored those involved in the tea trade over the food producers.
